title: UAPF MCP Execution Binding
description: The per-package MCP execution binding, declared under exposure.mcp in a UAPF package manifest (uapf.yaml). It controls how a package's runnable processes and decisions are surfaced as MCP tools by a conforming UAPF->MCP implementation (e.g. the reference uapf-mcp / uapf-mcp-go server in front of a UAPF engine, or the ProcessGit /{owner}/{repo}/uapf-mcp scope). All fields are OPTIONAL and backward compatible: an absent binding means the implementation exposes its default execution tool surface for every runnable entrypoint. This schema mirrors the exposure.mcp object embedded in uapf-manifest.schema.json and exists so the binding can be referenced on its own.

enabled.description: Whether this package is exposed over MCP at all.

runnable.description: Whether the package exposes runnable (execution) entrypoints over MCP, not only read/knowledge tools.

exposedEntrypoints.description: Filter + naming for the runnable surface. Each item is either a bare process/decision id, or an object mapping a process or decision to an explicit MCP tool name. Omit the field to expose all runnable entrypoints under the implementation's default tool names (see chapter 06).

tool.description: Explicit MCP tool name exposed for this entrypoint (overrides the implementation default such as uapf.run_process / uapf.evaluate_decision).

process.description: BPMN process id this tool runs (evaluated via the run-process / start-session surface).

decision.description: DMN decision id this tool evaluates (via the evaluate-decision surface). Deterministic; not interpreted by the agent.

exposedArtifacts.description: Which package artifacts are retrievable via the get-artifact surface.
